items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: My personal manager was Dagan... he say: 'Machito, I am going to book you, I am going to be your personal manager'. I said okay

ctx.x: Edmund O'Brien. So is a, you know, nice story and I don't want to brag about myself, but it was an accident, let's say. My personal manager was Dagan, that he was like a right hand of Paul Whiteman.
